title: carex onoei var. krameri
intro: Carex onoei var. krameri, commonly known as Krameri's sedge, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments due to its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Research has identified bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
